en: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?
Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!
{PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.

Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.

Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.
Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!

… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2}!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!
I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!
Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2}?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.
Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3} one you brought before.
Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.
Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.
The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3}!
It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.
